text: dsh-context-compression-improved 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的上下文压缩插件，通过可逆 preset overlay 将压缩栈接入非 Minimal 预设，并在设置界面提供多种压缩策略。它可压缩新产生或累积的工具结果、整理较早的工具输出、保留代码骨架，并展示节省统计与会话监控。用户可通过设置面板选择策略和阈值，也可用命令查看或控制面板及摘要开关。适合长时间运行、工具输出较多的 DeepSeek Harness 会话；需要支持的 Harness 版本，测量依赖对应 DeepSeek tokenizer。

dsh-context-compression-improved adds selectable context compression to DSH web sessions. It reduces fresh, accumulated, and older tool results, with an optional code-skeleton gate. A settings panel controls policies and thresholds; commands and monitoring show savings and session state.
想减少 DSH 长会话里工具输出占用的上下文。

我想查看压缩前后节省了多少 token。
How can I reduce context consumed by large tool outputs in DSH?

dsh-context-compression-improved 的功能「新结果压缩」：插件在工具结果首次暴露时按策略尝试缩减内容；代码骨架开关启用时，可保留导入与声明轮廓，并在不可用时回退。
dsh-context-compression-improved 的功能「压缩策略设置」：设置面板允许选择压缩 profile、调整自动 compact 阈值，并修改自定义策略；配置由运行时 schema 校验。
dsh-context-compression-improved 的功能「节省统计与监控」：插件注册统计和会话监控接口，并提供面板命令；界面可查看压缩节省指标及会话状态。
dsh-context-compression-improved 的功能「会话摘要控制」：/ctx-summary 命令可查看状态或临时暂停、恢复 turn-tail intent summary。

dsh-context-compression-improved README · dsh-context-compression-improved：> [!NOTE]
> **What this fork adds on top of upstream 0.1.0:**
>
> - An orthogonal **code-skeleton compression gate** (`codeSkeleton.enabled`, default off): the first exposure of an oversized fresh source-code tool result can keep a skeleton of imports and declarations — bodies elided, error lines kept — before the regular reducers run.
> - A settings toggle for that gate in the same selector settings section, independent of every compression profile.
> - An ESLint baseline wired into CI, a `test:watch` TDD loop, and documentation in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · dsh-context-compression-improved：> [!IMPORTANT]
> This project supports **DeepSeek models only**. Lossless measurement and lossy compression depend on the bundled official DeepSeek tokenizers (`deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`). Everything else fails open and keeps original tool results. See the [upstream README](https://github.com/WilliamShi666/dsh-context-compression-selector#model-support-and-safety) for the full safety model.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · dsh-context-compression-improved：> [!TIP]
> **Recommended: connect DeepSeek with your own API key via a custom Responses API endpoint.** Prefer a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`/v1/responses`) over the official-account Messages API route: it does not go through the Anthropic-style message serialization, so requests never trip message-format issues or `tool_use`/`tool_result` pairing validation (the official route's resume-replay 400s cannot be repaired from the plugin side), and you can switch endpoint nodes over time and keep existing sessions running.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · What it is：Long-running agent tasks accumulate a large amount of tool output. This community plugin adds selectable, auditable policies for reducing that tool-result context without modifying DeepSeek Harness core:

dsh-context-compression-improved README · What it is：- **Fresh** pre-compresses a newly oversized tool-result segment before the model receives it.
- **Aggregate** pre-compresses fresh material again when it still grows beyond its budget.
- **History / micro-compact** replaces eligible old tool results while preserving recent working context.
- **TailTrim** is an optional Custom-only tail reduction path.
- **Native** preserves the Harness-style head/middle/tail trimming as one explicit profile.
- **Code skeleton (new, orthogonal gate)** — see below.
dsh-context-compression-improved README · What it is：Every decision is recorded: stage, reducer, trigger, skip reason, and exact token counts where available.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Code skeleton gate (new)：When the gate is enabled, an oversized **fresh source-code tool result** (for example a large `read_file`) first tries a skeleton reduction: imports and type/function/class declarations are kept, function bodies are elided with a marker, and error lines inside elided bodies are preserved. If the skeleton cannot be produced or verified, the result falls back to the original head pruning — the gate can never make context worse.

Properties:

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Code skeleton gate (new)：- **Orthogonal**: independent of the selected profile (`balanced`, `savings`, `cache-strict`, `adaptive`, `custom`, `off`, `native`). All profiles get the gate.
- **Off by default**: `codeSkeleton: { enabled: false }` until you turn it on.
- **Measurement-gated**: requires the exact DeepSeek tokenizer; without it the plugin fails open.
- **Session-frozen**: like all selector settings, changes affect newly observed sessions only.
- **Strictly parsed**: `codeSkeleton` must be exactly `{ enabled: boolean }`; malformed values throw on the runtime side and show as unreadable in the browser UI.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Settings UI：Choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level, and toggle code-skeleton compression in the same settings section. The toggle saves on change and shows the saved state on reload.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Monitoring UI：While compression runs, the plugin gives you a live view of what it saves: a **compression monitor** panel — net/gross savings, offsets, context usage, cache-hit rate, cost estimate, and the turn-tail intent-summary state, with a per-session resume/disable override right in the panel — next to the session's context trend chart.

Context trend for a session under compression: per-step / per-turn token composition with a timing overlay; the scissors mark where reductions landed.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Stats semantics and persistence：- **Stock (currently active)** — net savings still in effect on the live surface; it rises and falls as compressed content moves in and out.
- **Cumulative (across N calls)** — the stock sampled at every request boundary and summed; answers "how much was saved historically" and survives host restarts.
- **Money saved** — cumulative weighted by cache hit/miss at official list prices (deepseek-official official routes only; other routes show the token figure).

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Stats semantics and persistence：Stats persist in SQLite (`~/.dsh/storages/dsh-context-compression/stats.sqlite`) across host restarts; a missing driver or write failure degrades visibly (panel badge, in-memory fallback). Historical sessions are backfilled from on-disk behavior records (host `sessionQuery` service preferred, read-only session-log parsing as fallback — session files are never written). Records contain counts, sequence numbers, session identifiers, and enum component names only; original text and free-form text never enter the database. Delete the file to reset stats completely.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Stats semantics and persistence：The `/ccip` command drives the panel in real time: `rows stock|total|money on|off`, `mode compact|full`, `session <id|latest|off>`, `flush`, `backfill pause|resume|status`.

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Install：**Recommended: install from npm.** One version covers every supported Harness line — `latest` carries the full 17-rc enum (0.1.0-rc.2 → 0.2.1-rc.2); the runtime picks per-line code paths on its own.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-compression-improved@latest
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

cd dsh-context-compression-improved
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

Then pack the selector package and add it to a Harness profile — the full walkthrough, including verification and uninstall steps, is in the [installation guide](docs/installation.md).

Contributions follow the upstream discipline: add the failing regression first, keep every production change inside this repository, and explain “triggered”, “enabled but skipped”, and fail-open evidence separately. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

dsh-context-compression-improved README · Compatibility：- Built and tested against the official DeepSeek Harness releases; peers declare the full supported-hosts enum (`0.1.0-rc.2` → `0.2.1-rc.2`, seven lines) and the plugin uses public plugin and profile APIs only. The supported list is generated into the managed block above by `scripts/sync-hosts.mjs` from `scripts/hosts.mjs`.
- Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24` and pnpm `11.7.0`.
- The plugin uses only public Harness extension APIs and does not modify Harness core code. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
